name: reproai
description: ReproAI Prep: prepares a replication package for a journal's reproducibility check or a certification service. The static skills (check, comply, fix) scan a working directory, apply an author rule set and a venue profile (AEA, ...), and advise how to reorganize the package so a downstream reproducibility check passes on the first try — without executing author code. The optional debug and prepare skills run a copy: a smoke test (does it run, did the table and figure outputs appear), or a rehearsal that runs it twice the way a certification service such as IQSS Certify will. ReproAI Prep never compares coefficients and never issues a reproducibility verdict or a certificate.

author.name: Leo Yang Yang and Yiqing Xu
